Subject: Exec + Infra availability for 30-min intro — propose 2 windows and prep doc

Hi Alyssa —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery:

- Goal: 30-minute product intro tailored to exec (strategy) + infra (technical constraints) to validate fit for a small pilot.
- Key questions we heard: data residency options, latency SLAs for your busiest endpoints, and model lock/versioning during pilot.

To keep things tight, can we aim for a 30-minute session with this proposed agenda?
1) 5m — introductions + top success criteria
2) 15m — product walkthrough (focused on latency/cost controls)
3) 10m — open Q&A and next steps

Proposed windows (Pacific time):
- Option A: Tue May 11, 2026 — 10:00–10:30 AM PT
- Option B: Wed May 12, 2026 — 2:00–2:30 PM PT

If neither works, please share a couple of 30-min windows that suit both your exec and infra leads. Also let me know who will join from the Riverbend side (exec + technical SME).

Attached: RB-deck-v1.pdf (deck + short call notes) and a 30m-prep-checklist.md that lists what we’ll ask your infra team to have ready (sample logs, network egress policy, KMS notes).

If helpful I can also drop a Calendly link for direct booking — otherwise reply with preferred option and I’ll send the invite.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this on calendar.

Best,
Jonas Weber
